mapping.draft_py:
# Youthful Valkyrie (FDN), a 1/3 Angel with flying for {1}{W}.
# "Flying"                                 compiled keyword, kept
# "Whenever another Angel you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature."
# Event: M21 Terror of the Peaks' verified "Whenever another creature you control enters"
#   (ZoneChangeEvent to your battlefield, subject your creature and FNot IS_SOURCE) with the tribal
#   noun "Angel": SUBTYPE_EQ 'Angel' with TYPE_EQ 'Creature' (MAPPER_GUIDE, tribal nouns; M21
#   Watcher of the Spheres' "another creature you control with flying" adds its quality the same
#   way). Once per Angel (no once_per_event).
# Effect: M21 Lorescale Coatl's verified "put a +1/+1 counter on this creature".
angel_enters = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Angel'),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [angel_enters, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever another Angel you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

mapping.notes: M21 Terror of the Peaks' enters event with the tribal noun Angel; Lorescale Coatl's counter; one trigger per Angel. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/youthful_valkyrie_two_angels_at_once_two_counters.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/youthful_valkyrie_opponents_angel_gives_nothing.json.
